Name: Five Types of Hydrangeas
Author: zurakazura
Description:
[color=#ffe599][b][size=4][AT]模式[/size][/b]
[/color]
1.春季&夏季种植

2.在皮埃尔商店购买

3.为了防止不小心收割，设置成可以收获2次(白色木绣球3次)

4.做出来纯粹是为了好看的，可以送给NPC

5.花型参考的品种是“大海蓝”绣球和木绣球

6.有两个版本的颜色，可以选择喜欢的版本把文件【 [JA] Five Types of Hydrangeas 】复制到MOD文件夹里


[b][color=#fff2cc][size=4][CP]模式[/size][/color][/b]

[b]24.7.28
现在【CP】模式不会再替换原有的作物贴图，可以和JA模式一样皮埃尔商店买种子啦[/b]


——————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————


[b][color=#fff2cc][b][size=4][AT][/size][/b][/color][/b]

1. Planting in Spring & Summer

2. Buy at Pierre's Store

3. To prevent accidental harvesting, it's set to be harvested twice (white hydrangea can be harvested three times)

4. Created purely for aesthetics, can be given as a gift to NPCs

5. The flower shapes are inspired by "Ocean Blue" hydrangeas and wooden hydrangeas

6. There are two versions of colors available. Choose your preferred version and copy the file named "[JA] Five Types of Hydrangeas" into the MOD folder.

[b][color=#a4c2f4]24.7.27
Now the [CP] mode will no longer replace the original crop textures, and seeds can be bought from Pierre's Store.[/color][/b]
